title: The Concordance Engine v0.1.1 (Tier B): Reference Implementation of the Logotic Technique Catalogue
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A Tier B software reference implementation of the **Logotic Technique Catalogue**. The Concordance Engine is not a production service or autonomous agent suite; it is a complete reference architecture with one runnable Critique Loop and the prompts, schemas, middleware, templates, and governance documents needed to extend the pattern.

The deposit reports a 75-file bundle, an end-to-end Anthropic implementation, a zero-secret mock mode, five agent prompts, eight skill specifications, five middleware specifications, a Neo4j-compatible Aperture Atlas schema, four deposit templates, twelve offline smoke-test invariants, and SHA-256-linked revision provenance. Multi-provider verification and six additional executable operatives remain deferred to Tier C.
reading: Play → Touch → Method → Proof → Force → Force
journal: Transactions on Substrate Engineering (Trans. Substrate Eng.)
